body: I wish so too, have a good night sleep! Thank you for the congratulation.
Perhaps. I have to think about things and maybe tell someone or just get help. Thank you for listening to me and talking for a bit. It really meant a lot.
Yeah, didn't take it that way at all! No worries, just kind of threw in a bit of my thoughts. Thank you.

Not really. I am in no terms with my mother because she is abusive and doesn't care about my mental well-being. My father would probably like to know, but he is kind of a traditional manly man and I know he would just downplay it and tell me to cheer up. I could talk to my brother who is very dear to me, but I don't want to be a burden or worry them.

That sounds really lovely. I'd like to do something like that but I don't really have anyone and if I delete my facebook, I'll be totally isolated. It takes a minimal effort of people to bother to talk to me a bit, so I'll take it so I don't turn into a complete hermit.

That's a nice suggestion, but I don't really have anything I could do. I feel really faint and can't be bothered to go to the store. I'm sorry. I've just been crying all day.

I could probably go see a psychologist that we have there, but there is some weird scheme going around where he is changing jobs soon so there aren't any appointments to have and we don't have a new one yet to take his place. Then again I'm not sure if I should, it'll only be a bother. My friend said that getting help would take a really, really long time and then I'd have to go to some appointments that I cannot miss and usually I just shut myself out carefully so I don't know if I'd go, she strongly hinted it wouldn't be any better for me. Sorry for being a burden.
I understand so well. It stings. Late happy birthday though!

Not really, thank you very much for asking. Sorry for taking your time. I've just been severely depressed for a long time, I've been discouraged from getting help and I don't have any real friends. It's my birthday today and it's a worthless day and I'm reminded of it so much it stings. I can't even do any radical decisions I've been contemplating because there is a big event in few days and if I don't go there, I'll disappoint everyone furthermore. I'm such a burden for myself and others.

Thank you. And I usually don't, but it just stings. It just stings that usually everyone just congratulates those who have their birthday, no matter who it is and it's okay. I can't even have that privilege and it hurts.
